description: This file defines a Perl module for handling database result sets related to 'Terms' in the Coocook schema. It includes methods for ordering terms, retrieving terms valid on specific dates, and fetching today's terms.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Terms
classes.description: A Perl class representing a result set for 'Terms' in the Coocook schema, providing methods to query terms based on order and date validity.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Returns a search result ordered by 'valid_from' date, either ascending or descending based on the input parameter.

methods.name: valid_on_date_rs
methods.description: Retrieves a result set of terms valid on a specific date, ordered by 'valid_from' descending.

methods.name: valid_on_date
methods.description: Fetches a single row of terms valid on a specific date.

methods.name: valid_today_rs
methods.description: Retrieves a result set of terms valid today.

methods.name: valid_today
methods.description: Fetches a single row of terms valid today.
